description: An industrial tire company delivers large tires for equipment to remote engineering sites either by cargo planes or ultrawide trucks. Each cargo plane can transport 10 tires per trip and costs $1000. Each ultrawide truck can transport 6 tires per trip and costs $700. The company needs to transport at least 200 tires and has available $22000. Because most remote sites don't have proper airports, the number of plane trips cannot exceed the number of ultrawide truck trips. How many trips of each should be done to minimize the total number of trips?

TiresPerPlaneTrip.definition: Number of tires that can be transported by one cargo plane per trip

CostPerPlaneTrip.definition: Cost of one cargo plane trip in dollars

TiresPerTruckTrip.definition: Number of tires that can be transported by one ultrawide truck per trip

CostPerTruckTrip.definition: Cost of one ultrawide truck trip in dollars

MinTires.definition: Minimum number of tires to be transported

AvailableBudget.definition: Available budget in dollars for transportation

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of trips made by cargo planes and ultrawide trucks combined"

constraints.description: 10 * (number of plane trips) + 6 * (number of truck trips) must be greater than or equal to 200
1000 * (number of plane trips) + 700 * (number of truck trips) must be less than or equal to 22000
The number of plane trips must be less than or equal to the number of truck trips
The number of plane trips and the number of truck trips must be non-negative integers
